verdict.rationale: Quo's authentication docs say that "Each key provides full API access," so there are no scoped or least-privilege credentials. Separately labeled keys that can be deleted individually limit how far a revocation reaches, but that is an adjacent control, not permission scoping. The axis applies to a SaaS product with a public API, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
